West Indies's bowling response was spearheaded by JA Warrican (4/61), who generated sustained pressure and triggered critical breakthroughs to prevent runaway scoring. Concluding at 324/10 (92.4 ov), Bangladesh posted a competitive total, ensuring a closely matched contest.

Dismissed for 139/10 (35.2 ov), West Indies succumbed to fourth-innings pressure as Bangladesh's bowlers closed out the victory.

summaryTab.matchCommentary:
The Test match at Zahur Ahmed Chowdhury Stadium commenced with high tactical intensity as Bangladesh posted 324/10 (92.4 ov) in their opening innings. In response, West Indies countered with 246/10 (63.6 ov), setting the stage for a compelling contest of tactical endurance. Early sessions tested batting resolve against disciplined seam movement, with both attacks striving to gain the upper hand on a developing surface.

The defining turning point arrived during 6-Wicket Spell: Taijul Islam (6/33), which irrevocably altered the trajectory of the match. As the match progressed through its pivotal middle stages, JA Warrican delivered a masterclass for West Indies (53 Runs & 6 Wkts), absorbing intense pressure and tilting the momentum decisively. Crucial partnership stands and incisive bowling spells broke the opposition's resistance, shifting the control share (Bangladesh 45%) and allowing Bangladesh to dictate terms heading into the decisive sessions.

Entering the final innings, West Indies faced an uphill battle under unrelenting scoreboard pressure. Bangladesh's bowling unit, bolstered by Taijul Islam (40 Runs & 7 Wkts), maintained relentless discipline and attacked the stumps relentlessly. Wicket clusters in the closing sessions dismantled any remaining resistance, sealing Bangladesh won by 64 runs in comprehensive fashion.

Verdict: Bangladesh's triumph was built on superior pressure absorption, clinical execution during critical moments, and the ability to dominate key sessions. While West Indies produced fighting phases, Bangladesh won the pivotal turning points and sustained higher tactical control across all five days to emerge as deserved victors.
